candidates.name: Variational
candidates.summary: Official documentation targets a Q4 2026 token launch, without an exact date. Variational operates an on-chain derivatives product. No public token sale or confirmed listing venue was identified in the official sources checked. This is a research candidate, not a current purchase opportunity.
risks: 32% of total supply is allocated to a genesis airdrop and is fully unlocked at launch, creating potential selling pressure.
50% is allocated jointly to team and investors, locked for 12 months after launch and then vesting over at least three years; the separate team and investor shares remain undisclosed.
Launch price, fully diluted valuation, initial circulating supply and token eligibility remain unconfirmed. Using derivatives to earn points carries separate loss and liquidation risk.
